title: Shop And Owned Inventory UI
acceptance: A Shop screen (five categories, ownership and acquisition filters, cards, item details) and an Owned view with equipped markers, reachable from the HUD and Mansion, with one consistent back behaviour and kept filter and scroll position.
Loading, empty-catalog, unavailable-data and owned states are honest: no fake prices, no Buy button without a supported grant path, unknown ownership never shown as unowned.
Server exposes read-only catalog and ownership remotes (validated, rate-limited); UI specs for state logic; Studio screenshots at desktop and phone widths; check.sh green; one Sonnet audit.
